Hey Will,

Thank you for getting back to me so quickly, and it was truly great getting the chance to meet and speak with you.

At this time, we are only moving forward with team members who are able to fully align with our non-compete requirements regarding other aesthetic growth and consulting companies. As we continue building urlThe Luxora Collectivehttps://www.theluxoracollective.co, we are focused on creating a highly dedicated and aligned team that is committed exclusively to the vision and long-term growth of our company.

Our agreement is designed to protect both our team members and the company as a whole, so unfortunately it is a requirement for anyone joining the organization.

That said, I genuinely appreciate your transparency and professionalism throughout the process. I enjoyed our conversations and absolutely respect your position. We wish you nothing but success moving forward and appreciate the time you invested with us.

Warm regards,

Bethany Anne Gifford

On Wed, May 20, 2026, 5:59 PM William Ford Wymer <w.f.wymer@gmail.com> wrote:
Hey Bethany,

Yeah, I spoke with Eric. He said he'd give me a call back after he got done with the contractor. I waited, but never got a call. I'll message you the questions I had for him.

"Hey Eric,
A few quick questions:
1) On the "Saved Prospects" menu, is there anyway to get the phone numbers displayed on this list? I'd like to see the OPP score and the number on the same page.
2) On the "Saved Prospects" menu, is there anyway to remove them without disqualifying them?
3) Do I use my personal phone and email, or is there another program for that?
4) Is there a contact for the tech guy, or do I go through you?"

Further, I declined the contract and sent it back, as I can't do a noncompete.
